summary.motive: Weaponize the pistol run identity to vacate the deep middle, then attack it with a post shot off a half-roll.
summary.whyItWorks: The downhill mesh forces both second-level defenders and the robber to trigger before the quarterback ever looks downfield, isolating the middle third against two routes.
summary.failureMode: The safety plays run-pass split discipline instead of triggering, keeping his shoulders square to the post developing behind the crosser.

beats.title: 1. The Identical Zone-Read Sell
beats.text: Every cue from the pistol inside zone read is present: the same mesh, the same line footwork, the back carrying the ball downhill into the second level.

beats.title: 2. The Safety Trigger
beats.text: The robber fires down on the run action while the Mike triggers onto the diving back. Both vacate the middle of the field before the ball moves.

beats.title: 3. Roll-Out Flood Builds
beats.text: The quarterback half-rolls off the fake as the flood develops: the crosser drags the free safety's eyes while the tight end releases late into the hole.

beats.title: 4. Post Behind the Frozen Third
beats.text: Z breaks off his go route into the post lane behind a middle-third defender who never recovered from the run fit. The shot lands over the trailing corner.

relations.tell: The slot releases across the formation instead of arcing to kick a linebacker, and the line finishes with pass-set feet — live runs never do either.
